hook: An AI broke ciphers experts never cracked

beats.say: MiniMax says an internal research model produced the first practical attacks on several NIST competition candidates that had no known practical breaks.
It found full collisions in SHA-3 candidate Blender-256 in seconds, and shrank a LOCKER solver matrix from 42 petabytes to 58 megabytes.
It also found over a dozen unreported bugs in reference code, including one typo that let it forge signatures using only the public key.
